**Wrong data is faster to fix than a bug.**
If a course description, prerequisite
or room detail is wrong, a one-line PR to `data/` lands within a day. Say where
you saw the right version and open it directly.

### Screenshot

Optional, and worth more than a paragraph for anything visual. The comment box
on the site cannot take a file - drop the image on the GitHub thread instead,
or paste a link to it from anywhere that hosts one.
